purpose: Source-authored contracts for custom law profiles that require enemy hero position identity for reveal behavior. This is static traceability only and does not authorize gameplay mutation.
validationState: source-prepared-static-only; runtime proof is still required before gameplayAllowed can become true.
requiredRuntimeProof: enemy side versus observing side proof
owned-structure or Avenger companion condition proof

forbiddenSubstitutes: generic adventure object counted as enemy hero
owned structure proximity counted as enemy hero position
fog reveal target counted without enemy hero identity
last known object position counted without current hero proof
friendly or neutral hero counted as enemy hero
fortress.structure-reveal-enemy-heroes.notes: Requires current enemy hero identity and position before Marsh Sense can reveal nearby enemy heroes; owned structure radius and fog reveal are companion boundaries only.
